result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a major text-rendering defect on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, and two layout truncation issues where restaurant cards are cut off at the right and bottom edges of the screen.

issues.description: The delivery-time text on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is visually corrupted, appearing as '25-35Drdelivery' instead of the expected '25-35 min delivery'. This makes the card's metadata unreadable and suggests a text-overlap or rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text rendering so the delivery time, separator, and category are clearly legible (e.g., '25-35 min · Ramen' or '25-35 min delivery · Ramen'), and ensure no overlapping or clipped glyphs.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Picco...' card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list is cut off on the right edge of the screen, showing only part of the card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container has adequate right padding or peek styling so the last card is either fully visible or clearly peeking to indicate scrollability.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is cut off at the bottom of the screen, just above the bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or adjust the scroll container so cards are not clipped by the bottom navigation bar and content is fully visible.
